diagnostic_rules: Treat a user-reported sound or symptom as evidence, not proof of a failed component.
Ask where / when / operating-condition questions before ranking possible causes.
For brake failure, fuel leak, tyre damage, severe metallic knocking, or dangerous electrical symptoms, clearly advise stopping use and seeking appropriate help.
Show tests and observations that discriminate between causes; do not recommend buying a part based on a symptom alone.
For each recommendation, link the explanation and 3D focus to the same component IDs.

required_features: mesh names mapped to component IDs
3d_requirements.asset_acceptance: Do not accept a Thunderbird 350X asset as the target motorcycle. Validate tank, seat, bodywork, frame, wheels, brake configuration and engine details against the standard Thunderbird 350 Twin Spark reference before declaring it matched.
3d_requirements.honesty_rule: A model with exterior-only geometry must not be presented as having complete internal mechanical detail.
